business_problem: To account for supply chain and transportation costs associated with products sourced from Asia, Hampton wanted to improve the agility of systems that track costs.
solution_summary: Hampton Products, a Manufacturing organization in United States, modernized this customer service automation workload with Dynamics 365 Finance, and Microsoft Copilot. To account for supply chain and transportation costs associated with products sourced from Asia, Hampton wanted to improve the agility of systems that track costs. Dynamics 365 Finance standardizes finance, accounting, and operational processes on one business platform. Microsoft Copilot adds a conversational AI layer that helps staff search, summarize, and generate work products inside Microsoft applications. Hampton Products connects warehouse systems into Microsoft 365 services, grounds responses through Microsoft Copilot, and serves generated answers and drafts back to users through Dynamics 365 Finance. Hampton secures warehouse efficiency with Dynamics 365.
